items.title: Lam Research (NASDAQ:LRCX) Reports Q2 In Line With Expectations, Stock Soars
items.summary: Semiconductor equipment maker Lam Research (NASDAQ:LRCX) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 30% year on year to $6.72 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $8.1 billion, coming in 13.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.82 per share was 8.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Lam Research (LRCX) Is Down 16.3% After China Lithography Jitters Hit Chip-Equipment Sentiment
items.summary: In recent days, Lam Research has been caught in a broad semiconductor pullback as investors weigh upcoming earnings, tighter Federal Reserve expectations, and escalating Middle East tensions alongside sector-specific worries about new Chinese lithography capabilities. This mix of macro uncertainty and potential shifts in China-related chip equipment demand has put extra focus on how Lam’s business is exposed across regions and end markets.
